title: StarterGui:SetCore()
summary: Configures core Roblox UI from scripts: chat visibility, badge toasts, reset-button behavior, hints — via string keys like SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", bool). Must be called from the client, and may need retries early in startup.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Depends on the key (boolean, table, string).

details.heading: Startup race
details.body: Core scripts may not be loaded when your LocalScript starts — SetCore can error then. The standard fix is a pcall retry loop.

explanation.whatItIs: A string-keyed control panel for the built-in UI layer you can't parent into directly.
explanation.whyItExists: Core UI (chat, health, reset) is injected by the engine; SetCore is the sanctioned knob panel.
whenToUse: Disabling/overriding the reset button in minigames
Toggling default HUD pieces for custom experiences
whenNotToUse: Server scripts — SetCore is client-side only
As a substitute for building your own UI when you need real control
tips: Retry-with-pcall wrapper is the community standard
commonMistakes: Calling once at startup and silently failing (core not ready)

examples.title: Reliable SetCore wrapper
examples.code:
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local function safeSetCore(key, value)
    for attempt = 1, 10 do
        local ok = pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore(key, value)
        end)
        if ok then return true end
        task.wait(1)
    end
    return false
end

task.spawn(function()
    safeSetCore("ResetButtonCallback", false)  -- no reset menu in this minigame
end)
